notes.title: Now available for Mac OSX!
notes.notes:
Yes, Battlegrounds of Eldhelm is now available for Mac OSX. 
We won't let you down Apples! :)

Apart from this, just to let you know that Battlegrounds of Eldhelm is constantly been updated and improved. In case you haven't played for a while, come back and check what is going on!

We are getting close to the release of our third expansion, introducing new campaigns and a brand new hero!

We would love to hear from you, leave us your comments via the game feedback form, in the community hub or in our forum.

Best Regards,
Eldhelm Team

notes.title: Levels above 99
notes.notes:
Hi fans and friends,

There were numerous questions regarding the maximum hero level and what happens when you complete level 99 ...

Well, here is the answer :)
We have implemented the so called "reputation levels"! Your hero won't go above 99 but after completing it he will start rising reputation levels. Your hero won't gain any new stat points, but on every new reputation level he will had to choose a Relic card s reward to aid him in his battles.

Relic cards are a brand new card class designed for advanced heroes and given as reward only for those reached the reputation levels.

Regards,
